dedupe_keys.name: digitales baumkataster munster municipal tree cadastre

description: The digital tree cadastre of Münster gives the coordinates and species group of city-maintained trees. The city's office for green spaces, environment and sustainability (Amt für Grünflächen, Umwelt und Nachhaltigkeit) cares for about 100,000 trees in parks, along streets and paths, at playgrounds, schools and nurseries and in woods, and just under half of them are digitally recorded in this dataset. Inside the Promenade ring the data reflect 2020; outside it they reflect 2017 and are incomplete. Trees on private land or under other bodies such as Straßen.NRW, the state of North Rhine-Westphalia or Deutsche Bahn are not included. Coverage is the City of Münster. Format and access: CSV download, WFS services in versions 1.0 to 2.0 and an HTML preview. Licence: Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0; free. Caveats: only about half of city trees and none of the private ones are covered, and only coordinates and species group are given. It supports urban heat and storm-damage exposure studies. Related catalogue records are Münster's municipal green space outlines and the Leipzig tree register.
